{{Quote|Are you staring at my rear end?|Jesmin Tainer to Trey Courser|<ref name="Mercy Kill" />}}
'''Trey Courser''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] machine and [[Droid/Legends|droid]] fabricator who served [[Wraith Squadron]] and was part of a team to serve in their investigation of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]]'s guilt into the [[Lecersen Conspiracy]]. In [[44 ABY]], he played a special role in framing Thaal when he was disguised as the General via a [[neoglith masquer]] created by fellow Wraith [[Viull Gorsat|Viull "Scut" Gorsat]]. In this disguise, he helped kidnap famed pop star [[Ledina Chott]], who Thaal was planning to marry. The mission to determine Thaal's guilt was successful and he was arrested as [[Stavin Thaal|Thadley Biolan]] under the assumption that Biolan was posing as Thaal and that the real Thaal was dead.<ref name="Mercy Kill" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|Four's our machine and droid fabricator. Light-duty computer slicer. Come to think of it, most of us are light-duty computer slicers. And he’d be our trainer, if any of the rest of us ever exercised.|Myri Antilles about Trey Courser|<ref name="Mercy Kill" />}}
Trey was Wraith Squadron's tech expert, Turman mentioned that he 'exercises constantly' and his muscular frame is mentioned throughout the story, so he is presumed to have above-average physical strength.<ref name="Mercy Kill" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I can't leave any device, vehicle, or construction unchanged. You know that.|Trey Courser|<ref name="Mercy Kill" />}}
By [[Human/Legends|Human]] standards, Trey was a fairly muscular and handsome man of fair complexion and brown hair that got lighter (blond) when exposed to sunlight. He specialized in machine-tinkering for Wraith Squadron, and had a somewhat fun, lighthearted personality. He enjoyed flirting, as demonstrated with his interactions with the female members of the squad, most notably [[Jesmin Tainer]].<ref name="Mercy Kill" />
